context: A boss and his manager discuss a long-form legal magazine piece
purpose: Teach: 浄化/鉱山/過酷/添加/ガード/租税/陪審/懲役

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: あの法律雑誌の長編記事、ついに陪審制度の特集が組まれたらしいな。
lines.en: That legal magazine's long piece — apparently they finally ran a feature on the jury system.
lines.style: Boss opens with magazine news, mildly impressed tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、読みました。租税回避の章と並べて掲載されていて、構成が骨太でしたね。
lines.en: Yes, I read it. They placed it alongside the chapter on tax avoidance — the structure felt really substantial.
lines.style: Manager responds thoughtfully, appreciating editorial structure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 特に、あの鉱山事故の被告に懲役十年が下ったケースの分析は読み応えがあった。
lines.en: The analysis of that mining accident case where the defendant got ten years in prison was particularly compelling.
lines.style: Boss highlights a specific case, engaged and serious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 現場の過酷な労働環境を、写真付きで丁寧に追っていましたよね。
lines.en: They traced the brutal working conditions on site very carefully, with photographs included.
lines.style: Manager agrees, noting investigative journalism quality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 排水の浄化装置が機能していなかったという指摘も鋭かった。
lines.en: The point about the wastewater purification equipment not functioning was also a sharp observation.
lines.style: Boss adds technical detail, showing he read closely.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、しかも違法な添加物の問題まで踏み込んで書かれていて、踏み込みが深いと感じました。
lines.en: Yes, and they even went into the issue of illegal additives — I felt the reporting went really deep.
lines.style: Manager extends praise, respectful tone toward boss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ただ、最後の章で工場のガードマンの証言を匿名にした判断は、議論を呼ぶだろうな。
lines.en: However, the decision in the final chapter to keep the factory guard's testimony anonymous will surely spark debate.
lines.style: Boss raises a critical concern, weighing journalistic ethics.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。来週の編集会議で、うちの法務とすり合わせておきます。
lines.en: You're absolutely right. I'll align with our legal team before next week's editorial meeting.
lines.style: Manager closes with professional commitment, deferential.
